points: 87% of German firms expect higher cyber budgets (prior year 77%); 47% expect +6-10%
51% plan agents to remove malware and restore systems; 46% to close vulnerabilities automatically
Survey of 3,934 executives in 71 countries, 277 in Germany, May-July 2026
read: PwC Deutschland, Digital Trust Insights 2027, 21 October 2026
take: German security leaders are ready to hand containment and patching to AI agents, and budgets are rising. CISOs need guardrails for autonomous response now.
title: PwC Digital Trust Insights 2027: 29% of German firms let AI agents defend alone
